myths.title: Origins
myths.text: Arhat appears in buddhist tradition as worthy one, saint. The name's meaning, "an Arhat or superior divinity with the Jainas", shapes the narratives told about this figure.

myths.title: Worship and Memory
myths.text: Devotees and later tradition-keepers preserved Arhat in ritual, text, and iconography, ensuring the name survived into the modern scholarly record.

lore.culturalLegacy: Arhat remains a touchstone for understanding buddhist religion, art, and identity.
